# Blyskode

> Blyskode is a software and technology agency based in Islamabad, Pakistan, working remotely with clients worldwide. Blyskode helps startups, SaaS companies, and growing enterprises build AI-powered products and scalable cloud platforms.

## What Blyskode does

Blyskode delivers across three core practices:

- **Product Engineering** — full stack web development, mobile app development, custom software, and quality assurance.
- **AI & Automation** — AI engineering, LLM integrations, agentic automation workflows, and machine learning.
- **Cloud & DevOps** — cloud architecture and migration (AWS, Azure, GCP, Huawei Cloud, DigitalOcean, Alibaba Cloud), CI/CD, multi-platform deployment, observability, and cost optimization.

Blyskode also offers end-to-end technical recruitment, SEO & digital marketing, and content writing.
